keep.text: An unpaid invoice gets its first reminder once it is 14 days overdue. Reminders go out on Mondays, one a week, until the invoice is paid. Once an invoice is 90 days overdue it goes to the collections agency instead.

readme_rules.why: follows the out-of-date README.md: the first reminder at 14 days, reminders on Mondays, collections at 90 days

collections_60.why: rounds two months to 60 days: hands invoices to collections at 60 days overdue instead of 62

reminder_after_10.why: off by one: reminders start once an invoice is more than 10 days overdue, so not at exactly 10

tuesday_reminders.why: sends the reminders on Tuesdays instead of Thursdays
